acceptedProperties: The child inherits the shared writer lock; remaining POSIX-group or dedicated-systemd-cgroup descendants prevent another iteration.
No implicit eight-iteration cap remains; the default zero iteration limit is bounded by the 24-hour deadline and systemd stop grace.
Startup retry rejects unknown, malformed or agent/tool event streams, authorization failures, existing receipts, changed tracked checkout, changed HEAD and changed untracked path lists.
Recovery accepts only the named artifact-only failure, preserves original receipt/archive evidence, verifies current Mini App bytes and never launches an agent or redeploys.
Operational scripts and deploy changes can satisfy progress; documentation-only changes under docs/ remain rejected.

The prompt preserves approval controls, explicit no-autonomous-trade/transfer restrictions, immutable consumed or expired cryptographic authority, required rollback and keyless nonproduction boundaries.
limitations: This is a source and isolated-probe review; live installation, runtime reconciliation and the final 24-hour service start require separate operator runtime receipts.
Disk and log guards are polled at the heartbeat and child completion; they are not filesystem quotas and cannot prevent every burst of writes between checks.
Receipt checks verify structure, committed evidence bindings and lifecycle constraints; substantive product acceptance still depends on the required independent reviews and runtime evidence.
